data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 67.7 million in 2021, representing a 2.03% reduction of its opening gross claims outstanding. This overall release was a result of mixed movements across different lines of business. Discontinued lines experienced adverse development totalling GBP 94.0 million, primarily driven by US trucking liability, International Casualty, Contractors sub-class of US Casualty, Aviation, and other P&C UK classes, due to adverse experience and changes in development patterns. This was partially offset by a release in Pro Rata. Conversely, the Insurance division saw net reserve releases of GBP 23.0 million from favourable performance in classes such as Cargo, Marine Liability, Commercial Property (including prior year cat releases), War, Financial Lines, and Credit. The Reinsurance division also benefited from net reserve releases of GBP 31.0 million, including a GBP 7.0 million release related to 2020 COVID losses and favourable performance in Cat NA and Cat International. The overall movement was also influenced by the absence of initial COVID losses in 2021 and the impact of the Supreme Court ruling on business interruption claims. Management also considered the impact of heightened inflationary environment on longer-tailed classes.

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development for specific LOBs (Insurance and Reinsurance divisions) are quoted as net figures in the narrative, while the Discontinued lines figure is gross. The overall syndicate prior year development is gross. The claims development triangle is present but deemed unreliable for prior year development calculation due to potential distortions from the Part VII transfer (RITC) in 2020, as per the extraction rules.
